title: Khaya
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Khayadhammo khayadhammo ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante khayadhammoti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha khayadhammo || vedanā || saññā || saṅkhārā khayadhammo || viññāṇaṃ khayadhammo || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyati pajānātīti || ||
